name: Heart of Neolithic Orkney
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: On Mainland, the largest of Scotland's Orkney Islands, this cluster of 5,000-year-old monuments includes the chambered tomb of Maes Howe, the standing stones of Stenness, the great Ring of Brodgar stone circle and the village of Skara Brae. Together they show how farming communities lived, worshipped and buried their dead on a remote northern archipelago, in a landscape still dotted with unexcavated mounds.
